Introduction

GIRLSET, formerly known as VCHA, is a four-member global girl group under JYP Entertainment. Originally six, the group was formed through the survival show "A2K", in collaboration with Republic Records. They promote in both the United States and South Korea.

The group released their pre-debut single, "SeVit (NEW LIGHT)", on September 22, 2023, and made their official debut on January 26, 2024, with the single album "Girls of the Year".

However, on March 11, it was announced that Kaylee would be on hiatus due to a health condition, until further notice. Later, on December 7, JYP Entertainment announced KG's departure from the group following her lawsuit against the company. On July 11, 2025, JYPE and Kaylee announced her departure from both the group and JYPE on SNS.

After a lengthy hiatus, on August 6, 2025, it was revealed that VCHA had rebranded to GIRLSET.

The name GIRLSET reflects a commitment to setting their own, boundless path and redefining what they could be. Rooted in diversity, unity, and self-determination, GIRLSET blends pop with hip-hop, R&B, and electronic sound, delivering dynamic performances with a global point of view.
